**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $1 050 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (2024 Q1)  
> • Redfin Data Center – “California Median Home Price” (2024)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 2023 estimates  

> **Quick note:**  
> * The median price is often quoted because it is less affected by a few very high‑priced properties.  
> * The mean (average) price is higher because a small number of luxury homes pull the average up.  

If you need a more specific figure for a particular city or ZIP code, let me know!
